purpose: Determine whether the near-confirmed margin-observed residual Top48 cohort survives finite cash, lots, minimum commissions, T+1, blocked exits, duplicate holdings, and continuous slot reuse without tuning the policy.

interpretation.source_confirmation_failure: absolute stress-net HAC and moving-block 95% lower bounds were slightly below zero despite all three annual point estimates being positive

account.exit: fixed D20 close request with authoritative sellability deferral through D80
account.capacity_constraint: each order is capped at 0.5% of causal signal-day amount and the filled ledger is audited against the same limit
account.confirmation_account_restart: repeat the identical account from fresh 1000000 CNY at the first 2023 signal
account.corporate_action_accounting: primary account uses raw execution prices and costs, but multiplies holding value and sale proceeds by the pack-pinned back-adjust-factor ratio as a total-return equivalent; raw-price-only replay is retained as a sensitivity control
account.corporate_action_limitation: the factor method is a total-return equivalent, not an exact cash-dividend payment-date and odd-lot share ledger

risk_budget_diagnostic.derivation: target volatility divided by realized daily account volatility through 2022, clipped once to the declared interval
risk_budget_diagnostic.interpretation: mechanical risk scaling can improve usability but cannot repair or override the failed absolute alpha confirmation gate
